title: Queen/quilt pink/gray medallions
text: Queen/quilt pink/gray medallions. It's lightweight... not the highest quality... but it works. I knew I was buying something light at this weight.  I like "quilts" as you mostly can machine wash them at home.  The color is described as "pink/gray".... but it's actually coral/light orange and a sort of taupey color -  think coral/brownish.. I added a pic to try and help with that.. In case the color matters to you. I personally am actually glad it's not "pink!" It's very nice looking on the bed. The full/queen comes with 2 shams -  first wash went well.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
